UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

(module scope)

A pickable node: engine ids + the JS-side state the arms animate.

node

Engine node id (set_position/set_scale/set_euler target).

mat

Material id — set_color writes the live opacity.

x

World position — picking ray sphere-test center.

radius

Sphere radius for hit tests (pulse widened).

path

Manifest path — onPick payload + highlight key.

baseOpacity

Resting opacity (dir/file token).

activeScale

Active-highlight scale multiplier applied in the pulse write.

(module scope)

A dir label: sprite node + material + the zoom-reveal bucket.

node

Engine sprite node.

mat

Sprite material — per-frame set_color alpha is the fade.

depth

Ring depth — the reveal threshold input.

a

Last written alpha — dirty-gated so idle frames write nothing.

parseInk

Parses a CSS color string into 0-1 rgb channels — the engine takes raw f32 triplets where the three path passed a THREE.Color. Handles rgb()/rgba() and #rgb/#rrggbb (what getComputedStyle emits); anything else falls back to white — unreachable in real browsers, which always resolve color to an rgb() serialization.

  • @param css Computed color string.
  • @returns [r, g, b] in 0-1.

poseFromPos

Converts a saved world-space camera position into the orbit rig's spherical pose — the inverse of the Rust rig's target + d·(cos p·sin y, sin p, cos p·cos y).

  • @param p Saved eye position.
  • @param t Saved orbit target.
  • @returns [distance, yaw, pitch].

buildEdges

Expands the parent→child edge list into cross-quad ribbon geometry — two perpendicular quads per edge (the engine draws triangles only; a crossed pair reads as a 1px line strip from every angle). SoA upload: positions + zero normals (basic material is unlit) + zero uvs + triangle indices.

  • @param placed Flattened tree.
  • @param positions xyz triplets per node.
  • @returns The four attribute arrays for upload_geometry.

mountArchScene3d

Mounts the scene3d arm: engine → orbit rig → async graph build → rAF loop. Returns null on ANY engine/artifact failure — the caller (mountArchScene) drops to the three.js path, so this mount can never regress the portal.

  • @param canvas Target canvas (same element the three path uses).
  • @param roots Manifest root buckets.
  • @param onPick Called with the manifest path on a node pick.
  • @returns The scene handle, or null when the engine can't mount.

saveCamState

Serializes camera pose + interaction flag into sessionStorage.

graphRoot

Root group — the intro-settle euler target (three's scene.rotation).

activePath

Docs path currently highlighted — '' matches the portal-root node.

applyActive

Paints the active-location highlight onto live nodes — same rules as the three arm: exact match pops to SCENE_ACTIVE_OPACITY with a larger pulse scale, ancestors lift to SCENE_ANCESTOR_OPACITY.

buildGraph

Populates the scene once positions land — shared dir/file sphere geometries, per-node materials (opacity arms), cross-quad edges, then dir-name labels on top.

  • @param xyz Worker/local position triplets.

pick

Nearest sphere hit along the picking ray — the JS half of Raycaster.intersectObjects: solve |o + t·d − c|² = r² per node (per-pick loop over pickables, never per-frame).
